question: Devadasi National Award is given at the dance festival held at the pilgrim centre in the state of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Devadasi National Award is an honor given to distinguished individuals in the field of dance.
 
• This award ceremony takes place annually at the Devadasi National Dance Festival.
 
• The festival is held at the pilgrim town of Puri in Odisha.
 
• The award recognizes excellence in classical dance forms, particularly Odissi dance.
 
• The Devadasi National Festival is a significant cultural event that attracts artists and audiences from across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Odissi Dance:**

 
 
• Odissi is one of the eight classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is known for its grace, fluidity, and expressiveness.
 
• The dance form is characterized by intricate movements of the head, bust, and torso.
 
• Odissi traditionally depicts religious stories and spiritual ideas, particularly those of Vaishnavism.
 
 
 
• **Devadasi Tradition:**
 
 
• The term "Devadasi" refers to women who were dedicated to worship and service of a deity or a temple for the rest of their lives.
 
• The tradition has ancient roots and was prevalent in many parts of India.
 
• Devadasis were highly skilled in classical dance and music, performing in temple rituals and royal courts.
 
• The practice has faced significant social changes and criticism over the centuries.
 
 
 
• **Puri:**
 
 
• Puri is a coastal city and a major pilgrimage site in the state of Odisha.
 
• It is famous for the Jagannath Temple, which is part of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites.
 
• Puri hosts the annual Rath Yatra, a significant religious festival attracting millions of devotees.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance:**
 
 
• The Devadasi National Festival is an effort to preserve and promote the rich cultural heritage of classical dance.
 
• It provides a platform for artists to showcase their talent and connect with a larger audience.
 
• Such cultural events play a crucial role in sustaining traditional art forms in the modern era.
